newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Rush of funds send Dhaka stocks soaring at close.
newsitem.headline: Rush of funds send Dhaka stocks soaring at close.

text.p: Dhaka shares closed 3.46 percent up on Thursday, one of the biggest single-session gains, after funds flooded in a market short of scrips, brokers said.
"The reason is huge funds chasing few shares. Even the laggard scrips gained amid euphoric buying by retail investors. Market needs fresh supply of shares," said one broker.

The Dhaka Stocks Exchange all-share price incdex rose 59.74 points, or 3.46 percent at 1,786.27 on a 194.1 million taka turnover. Of 99 issues traded, 80 closed up and 19 ended down. BD Lamps gained 926.15 taka to 6,588.87, Bangladesh Tobacco rose 21.51 290.09 and Beximco Pharam was up 1.29 to 190.84.
